reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows SPS at 2000°C produces single-phase, dense diborides, but it addresses high-entropy diborides, not single-phase ZrB2. The specific claim that SPS-processed ZrB2 will have lower porosity and better corrosion resistance than conventionally sintered ZrB2 is not directly supported by the cited passages, which lack data on conventional ZrB2 sintering or liquid plating bath exposure.
